question: According to the June 2025 report by the Centre for Legal Action and Behaviour Change (C-LAB), in which Indian state was the highest number of child laborers rescued in 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**तेलंगाना**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the report released by the **Center for Legal Action and Behavior Change (C-LAB)** in **June 2025**, the state of **Telangana** has emerged as the leader in rescuing child laborers during the **2024-25** period.
 
• The report highlights that **Telangana** conducted extensive rescue operations, particularly in industrial clusters and urban centers like **Hyderabad**, to identify and rehabilitate children forced into labor.
 
• The success in **Telangana** is attributed to the coordinated efforts of the **State Police**, the **Labour Department**, and various **Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs)** working under initiatives like **Operation Muskaan**.
